attacks.title: Night of 6–7 October
attacks.summary: Ballistic missiles struck non-residential and warehouse sites, a garage cooperative and open ground in four Kyiv districts overnight. Debris also hit the Dovzhenko Film Studio, and two deaths were reported in Darnytskyi district.

attacks.title: Night of 7–8 October
attacks.summary: Drone attack on Kyiv hit Solomianskyi, Sviatoshynskyi, Obolonskyi, Desnianskyi and Dniprovskyi districts, with fires in residential buildings, one man killed and several people injured.

dropped.title: Drone crash on highway
dropped.why: The only claim says the drone crashed 'on a highway near Kyiv'. It gives no district or address in the city. The site's own summary admits it may be outside city limits. It should not be published as a Kyiv city site.

audit_examples.explanation: The only claim says the drone crashed in front of a moving car "on a highway near Kyiv". It gives no district or address in the city. Near Kyiv suggests the oblast, so this is not an impact site inside Kyiv city.
audit_examples.public_note: This incident was on a highway near Kyiv and may be outside the city limits.

audit_examples.explanation: The only claim says the drone crashed 'on a highway near Kyiv'. It gives no district or address in the city. The site's own summary admits it may be outside city limits. It should not be published as a Kyiv city site.

attacks.title: Night of 16–17 November
attacks.summary: Russian ballistic missiles hit Kyiv's Northern and Southern bridges overnight, and falling debris started fires at warehouses and a residential yard. Buildings in Obolonskyi district and metro ground infrastructure were also damaged.

attacks.title: Night of 19–20 November
attacks.summary: Russian ballistic missiles and drones struck Kyiv overnight, damaging three bridges, causing fires in non-residential buildings and an office on an infrastructure site, and damaging a foreign embassy and a Kyivvodokanal facility.

audit_examples.explanation: c29 (posted 15:01) says 'внаслідок падіння уламків пошкоджена нежитлова будівля та автомобіль'. That is debris damage with a car involved. The other claims are fires in non-residential buildings ('загоряння двох нежитлових будівель'). Nothing ties c29 to those fires, so it should be a separate site.
audit_examples.public_note: A later report of debris damaging a building and a car in Podilskyi may be a separate incident from the fires.

audit_examples.explanation: c6 and c8 say 'влучання на відкритій території біля одного з мостів'. They don't name the bridge, and they describe a hit on open ground, not damage to the bridge. They were merged into the Podilsko-Voskresenskyi crossing without support, and it could be any bridge. They should be a separate site, or at least not be merged.
audit_examples.public_note: A hit on open ground near an unnamed bridge in Podilskyi may not be the Podilsko-Voskresenskyi crossing.
